_doc: Every deploy path has at least two routes, and at least one needs no credential a person would have to mint. Server-side only (owner, 2026-11-12): that credential-free route runs on a server-side platform, never on a person's computer. `person_free_credentials` lists the credentials that qualify and why; `none` is not one of them, because a route with no credential at all used to mean a person's own computer. scripts/check_routes.py fails the build otherwise (lesson 2026-11-11, doctrine/LESSONS.md).

github-builtin.why: GitHub mints the workflow token (GITHUB_TOKEN) itself at the start of every Actions run and revokes it at the end; no person creates, stores, pastes or renews it

routes.how: deploy/first-run/README.md: one click on the Deploy to Workers button; Cloudflare builds and deploys on its own servers
Cloudflare connector in a cloud-hosted Claude session
.github/workflows/cf-account.yml with a Cloudflare token bound as a repository secret

.github/workflows/loop.yml: the GitHub Actions host runs the same loop with its built-in token when the worker is silent; the cloud-hosted Claude routine (deploy/loops/claude-routine.md) is the other fallback
